sentences.en: We have a wide choice of fruits at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我们在超市有很多水果可以选择。

sentences.en: Would you go to the supermarket and get some butter?
sentences.zh: 你能去超市买些黄油吗？

sentences.en: We see each other at the supermarket now and then.
sentences.zh: 我们偶尔在超市见到彼此。

senses.zh: 超市，大型自助食品杂货店
